rawContent: I don’t protest. I advocate. There’s a difference in the tone. And there’s a difference in the language. That’s just the way I see it. PEACE !! #BlackLivesMatter
Not wanting to see Black people or anybody murdered by The Police apparently makes you a “Leftist”, whatever that means. #BlackLivesMatter

I’ll be on FREEDOM CORNER today, unless there’s inclement weather. The messages of PEACE ☮️ and SOLIDARITY must be shared w as many people as possible. PEACE to all of YOU. #BlackLivesMatter #IndigenousLivesMatter #FightTheHatred

When people shout out to me on FREEDOM CORNER “I know you’re getting paid” all they do is reveal information about themselves and nothing about me. But, of course, they would refuse to acknowledge that. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

Today on FREEDOM CORNER was amazing. Some people from work drove through the intersection. One knew about the effort and high-fives me. The others were like “whoa, what’s going on here?” PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

It’s either BLACK LIVES MATTER or they don’t from the perspective of each individual. There are no other options available. Which one are you going to advocate for? I’ll choose the former. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
Some guy on FB is trying to tell me I should stop using the BLM business logo. I just thought it was a 3 word declarative sentence. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

There R times at work where people will show me the PEACE ☮️ sign. That’s an unusual thing to do. It’s normal to just wave or say hello. I think some people may know about the FREEDOM CORNER effort but haven’t revealed that to me. But maybe I’m wrong. PEACE #BlackLivesMatter

The people who scream “get a life” to me on FREEDOM CORNER should scream “get a different life”. All they want is for me to stop advocating for Black Lives. But, of course, they must always speak in code to feel a sense of power. #BlackLivesMatter

FREEDOM CORNER is calling. And, luckily, I have the time and the energy to answer that call. May the sounds, words, and gestures of SOLIDARITY be heard and seen by all who are able to hear and see them. ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

This nice family decided to advocate on FREEDOM CORNER today. I saw them as I was driving through and had to join their effort. PEACE !! #BlackLivesMatter #IndigenousLivesMatter #FightTheHatred https://t.co/45laQJv5BG

Some guy on FB is telling me that my efforts as a Black Lives activist are having no impact. That may be true. But if it were true, he wouldn’t spend 30 minutes of his time trying to convince me of that. He’d just say nothing at all. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I’m amused when people say things “I’m sick of all the attention the Black Lives Movement is receiving”. As if there is a certain level of attention that would be just fine with them. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
A Black Guy in a group says to me “white lives matter”. I just said “great, go advocate for that”. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

A Black Guy on a motorcycle gives me attitude on FREEDOM CORNER and says “why you out here like this?” As if I must explain my actions to him. I quickly replied “why are you out here riding a motorcycle? That seems pointless to me.” PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

“Because I feel like it” is a legitimate reason to pursue any activity which any individual decides to pursue. But when a white person chooses to be a Black Lives activist some people seem as if they want a 10.000 word essay explaining that decision. ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

I’m truly at a point in my journey as an Activist where I don’t care about the reaction. I’m there to advocate for the Black Lives Movement. Even if Black People seemingly express disapproval about the effort, that’s their business and not mine. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I don’t need to go to movies, shows, or plays anymore. If I wish to be entertained, all I need to do is go to FREEDOM CORNER and proclaim that BLACK LIVES MATTER. The reaction to that effort is way more entertaining than any movie, show, or play. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

The people who tell me I advocate in the manner that I do just to get attention are simply being crybabies because The Black Lives Movement is receiving attention they desire for themselves. So they do anything to take away attention from the messages.  ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
The words “BLACK LIVES MATTER” are a message of SOLIDARITY. They are a message of UNDERSTANDING. PEACE ☮️ can only be achieved through UNDERSTANDING. PEACE to all of YOU !! #BlackLivesMatter
A gentleman is about to step onto FREEDOM CORNER in Muskegon, Muskegon and preach words of PEACE and SOLIDARITY. May the sounds of SOLIDARITY fill the air. PEACE ☮️ to EVERYONE !! #BlackLivesMatter

When people say “All Lives Matter” to me, I just say “do you advocate publicly for that?” Some actually respond “YES”. I say “great, tell me when, I want to watch and see what that’s like.” PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
Supporters of the FREEDOM CORNER effort are always very generous. They bought 4-5 bottles of water and big bag of potato chips for the Notorious Bob today. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I believe those who show no reaction at all to the FREEDOM CORNER effort are probably opponents who have grown weary of open air debate. Anyone who supports the effort would most likely want that to be known. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I was just at the grocery store. A random young white guy saw me. He said “R U the guy …..?” I didn’t say a word. I gave him a fist pump. And showed him the ☮️ sign. Moments like that just tell me the messages of ☮️ and SOLIDARITY are being received. PEACE !! #BlackLivesMatter

At this point, the FREEDOM CORNER effort takes place mostly to discuss the language of The Movement. I’ll preach about the words “Black Lives Matter” and the messages contained within those words. PEACE to ALL of you !! #BlackLivesMatter
Some idiots called the COPS on me. They said I was loud. That’s a crime, I guess. #BlackLivesMatter

From this point forward, if random people ask what I do at a social outing my response will be “I’m a Black Lives/PEACE activist.” Because that’s what I do. That’s my real work. My jobs are just what I do to get money. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter
I might legally change my name to The Notorious Bob. That way when the COPS ask for my name, I’ll say “The Notorious Bob. But you can call me TNB if you want.” PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

When I was new to activism, I loved talking about it to anybody who would listen. Now that I’m somewhat seasoned, excluding social media or being on FREEDOM CORNER or at a protest, I have no desire to talk about the issue at all. Or Y I do what I do. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter
One reason of many the FREEDOM CORNER effort takes place is to establish my own TRUTH. I know what I see and hear. Because I’m there. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

The sentence BLACK LIVES MATTER has no political affiliation attached to it. The reaction to those words as a statement should NOT be influenced by Politics. Those words R an acknowledgment of the oppressed condition & the existence of Systemic Racism. ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

More people on FREEDOM CORNER lately have been showing the universal symbol of SOLIDARITY w the Black Lives Movement. The effort has strongly encouraged that. Many times I’ll loudly chant “if you can’t show this symbol, then what do you represent?” PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

Even if I actually held a sign which said “All Lives Matter” on FREEDOM CORNER, the ALM rebels would probably find something to complain about. They’re a fussy bunch of people. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I bought new poster board yesterday. I’m going to make 10 new signs for FREEDOM CORNER today. 8 of them will be my words. Two of them can be yours. What do YOU want to say to the public? First two messages which R reasonable will be shared w the public. ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter
A few signs for FREEDOM CORNER today. PEACE !! #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/TkbGCr6yrv
A few other signs for FREEDOM CORNER today. PEACE !! #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/EWZyDZFokR
Just about everybody at my PT job supports the FREEDOM CORNER effort. One of the ladies I work with asks me today “why was that COP bothering you the other day?” PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

Two days from now, 5/25/2022 will be the two year anniversary of the George Floyd murder. I was thinking about going to Minneapolis but realized the cost of that trip was more than I desire to spend. But I’ll advocate locally. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

I bumped into a strong supporter of the FREEDOM CORNER effort in my apartment building this morning. I jokingly said to him “don’t tell anybody where I live”. Lol 😂 PEACE ☮️ It’s the 2 year anniversary of the George Floyd murder. #BlackLivesMatter

“If you in any way blame George Floyd for his own death after seeing what happened, you are speaking the language of The OPPRESSOR.” I chanted that many times today on FREEDOM CORNER. Many people understood exactly what was being said. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

Those who speak the language of OPPRESSION have a real difficult time admitting that. I’ll often chant on FREEDOM CORNER, “if you support OPPRESSION, just own it. Just be whoever you are. Don’t be wimpy about it.” #BlackLivesMatter

Whenever I can tell people are angry about the FREEDOM CORNER messages, I instantly move away from them. I’m there to advocate for The Black Lives Movement. I’m not there to babysit people. #BlackLivesMatter #IndigenousLivesMatter
Blaming George Floyd in any way for his own death, after seeing exactly what happened, is the language of The OPPRESSOR. #BlackLivesMatter
Bringing up Black on Black crime as a response to Black Lives Activists = Black People devalue their own Lives so why can’t White People do that as well. #BlackLivesMatter
I was interviewed today by a reporter. She asked some thoughtful questions. To which I responded thoughtfully. I can’t wait to see the article. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I showed this sign many times today. I was chanting “the effort here takes place for many reasons. One of which is to discover THE TRUTH. If the statement on this sign isn’t THE TRUTH, then please tell me what THE TRUTH happens to be using words.” #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/zN1FwzxVz0

Whenever I’m advocating for the Black Lives Movement on FREEDOM CORNER or anywhere, I speak the language of the OPPRESSED. Whereas those who oppose the messages shared by me speak the language of the OPPRESSOR. They R 2 distinctly different languages. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter
Not sure why people ask me if I’m getting paid when they’ve already determined their own answer. The concept of following one’s conscience completely eludes them. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
White People telling Black People how to interpret their own experience is the language of The Oppressor. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

Whenever I’m on FREEDOM CORNER, I let The Police dictate what our relationship happens to be. I won’t try to force it one way or the other. For the most part, it has been respectful. But I’m well aware that could change in an instant. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

Some people on FREEDOM CORNER claim they advocate their points of view (opponents and supporters) but they never tell me how they do it. I guess it’ll just remain a mystery. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter #IndigenousLivesMatter #FightTheHatred

I advocate for the Black Lives Movement. I don’t think about whether my actions have any effect. Because that isn’t decided by me. Other people can interpret the FREEDOM CORNER messages however they choose. That’s not a concern of mine or my business. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

I laugh every time I hear “all lives matter you fucking asshole” on FREEDOM CORNER. There’s at least 1 comment like that each time I’m out there. If they don’t instantly drive away, I say “if my life matters, why are you being mean to me?” in a playful way. #BlackLivesMatter

It’ll be interesting to see if anyone at work comments about the article published in MLive yesterday about The FREEDOM CORNER effort. I doubt anybody will shout out “all lives matter you fucking asshole” like they do on the street. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

Last night on FREEDOM CORNER, I shouted out loudly “R U in SOLIDARITY with this human rights movement?” as I was pointing to my Black Lives Matter sign. “The only answers are “yes, I am.” or “no, I’m not. It’s one or the other. What’s your position?” PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

I’m actually a little surprised that MLive (a media outlet) published a story about the FREEDOM CORNER effort. And the Muskegon Chronicle published the story as well. I didn’t think local media outlets would touch an issue like The Black Lives Movement. ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
As I’m walking through Muskegon with no BLM signs or clothing, a BLACK man who must have recognized me raised his fist in the air to show SOLIDARITY to the Movement. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

Next time some person on FREEDOM CORNER claims I’m getting paid to do what I do I’ll ask them “do you even know me name? do you even know my name? If you don’t, how can you claim to know anything about me at all?” PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

Even if you disagree with the claims being made by the Black Community and their advocates, you could still support The Movement. The Black Lives Movement is a conversation and an investigation. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

Now that there was an article about The FREEDOM CORNER effort, high school kids are showing up here and trying to be cool. I just finished a silly, non-thoughtful interview. But hey, at least they’re coming out here. That’s a start. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

Some guy tried the ALM crap. At least he had the balls to do it in front of BLACK PEOPLE. I shouted “ if U fiercely oppose this Human Rights Movement, you should be able to do exactly what I’m doing. Why aren’t you doing that?” #BlackLivesMatter

I’m walking out to the lighthouse on Pere Marquette beach in Muskegon. A couple of FREEDOM CORNER supporters offered some kind words. I m wearing an MLK shirt w no words on it. Maybe that helped them to make the connection. PEACE !! #BlackLivesMatter

2 years ago, I thought anybody who put BLM signs in their yard were hardcore activists. My definition of “hardcore activist” has changed since that time. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter #IndigenousLivesMatter #StopAsianHate

Let’s get right to the heart of the matter, shall we ? When it comes to The Black Lives Movement, you either believe there are Human Rights issues worthy of being investigated. Or you don’t believe that. That’s really all there is to it. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
WHITE PRIVILEGE is standing alone on FREEDOM CORNER advocating for Black Lives repeatedly and having NO FEAR to do that. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
I bet most of the people on FREEDOM CORNER who tell me to “get a life” are just aimlessly driving around Muskegon trying to figure out what they should do next. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
Just wanted to share this again for newer followers or longtime followers who may have missed it. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I wonder if opponents of The FREEDOM CORNER effort pass through on days I’m not there and thinks to themselves “thank God that asshole isn’t there”. I’d guess at least one person had that thought. Lol PEACE !! #BlackLivesMatter
SOLIDARITY is the word for the day. PEACE ☮️ !! #BlackLivesMatter

A few ALM rebels made a mistake tonight. After they said the only 3 words they know w time left until the light changed, I went on offense. I said “if that’s your position, then publicly advocate for it right here and right now. Are you too scared to do that?” #BlackLivesMatter

There’s advocating. And there’s advo-blading. That’s when I rollerblade around Muskegon while wearing my BLM shirt and shouting a chant here and there. It’s a nice change of pace for me because I become a moving target instead of a sitting duck. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

If you hear anyone say “public pressure” is the only reason Christopher Schurr was charged w second degree murder in the killing of Patrick Lyoya, that’s a dead giveaway they’re a Racist. That’s the language of The Oppressor. #BlackLivesMatter

You can bullshit all you want. But if you give a complete stranger the middle finger because he advocates on the street w a sign saying Black Lives Matter, then you’re a Racist. If that’s who you are, just own it. #BlackLivesMatter
Republicans are still confused by the fact that you can SAY “Black Lives Matter” even if you have no affiliation with the BLM Organization. It’s just a sentence. #BlackLivesMatter

People who shout out things like “Let’s Go Brandon” to me when I’m on FREEDOM CORNER prove how dumb they are. As if there’s some relationship between President Biden and my efforts as a Black Lives Activist. SMH !! #BlackLivesMatter

I took a nice nap. I feel well rested. Now it’s time to preach on the street about ☮️, SOLIDARITY, and UNDERSTANDING. It’s the right time to do that. PEACE to all of you !! #BlackLivesMatter #IndigenousLivesMatter #FightTheHatred

The really angry guy was back again on FREEDOM CORNER. Whenever he sees me he just starts swearing. I could see him at the grocery store and he’d just start swearing at me. He has anger issues. I’d guess he’s angry around other people. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

I met a couple of unhoused people on the street tonight. They’re both white. The guy said something to me like this “what’s up with the All Lives Matter response? Is that their way of telling you they’re Racists?” I said “that sums it up.” PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter
The thing I don’t understand with these #BlueLivesMatter people is if you quit being a COP do you still matter. You can’t quit being BLACK.

BLACK LIVES activists talk about COLOR because COLOR is the issue surrounding a JUSTICE Movement about skin color. Human Rights happens to be the main topic of this conversation. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I’m not sure what the objective of those who insult me or give me the finger on the street happens to be. If their objective is to entertain me and make me laugh, they have succeeded. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

When people express opposition to the messages on FREEDOM CORNER I’ll say “OK, we have a different perspective. I say PEACE to you. Are you able to say that to me?” The majority of opponents are unable to do that. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

When I was on FREEDOM CORNER this past Sunday a Black lady shouted “I support you” to me. It was nice of her to do that. Many people show gestures of support but it’s always nice to hear words. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I slayed the opponents tonight. That’s never the intention. I advocate. This was my chant “if U oppose what’s said here use words. B respectful. B civil w UR  approach. But most importantly, b original. Say something which has never been said b4 today.” #BlackLivesMatter

If I had to come up with 1 most important reason to publicly advocate for the Black Lives Movement it is this. The FREEDOM CORNER effort takes place to force people to confront an issue they’d prefer to ignore. This is done thoughtfully & gracefully. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

According to supporters of the FREEDOM CORNER effort I’m the coolest guy in town. According to opponents I need a mental health evaluation. I just say it’s possible both of those things are true. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter
HAPPY JUNETEENTH !! PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

If somebody tries to debate you about the Black Lives Movement, just ask them one simple question “Do Black Lives Matter? It’s either YES or NO. No other words are necessary.” Many times asking that question will end the conversation. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

All Lives Matter as a response to BLM = Black People aren’t worthy of attention. The sentence BLM is the language of the oppressed. If you don’t agree that oppression exists in the present day, then just say that. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

I know this will be considered a radical thought. When the conversation is about whether Black Lives Matter, the only responses which make sense are “Black Lives Matter” OR “Black Lives Don’t Matter”. Those are the only choices available to anyone. #BLM

WARNING : if you choose to be a visible street activist, it’s likely many people will think you’re weird. If that’s something you can’t handle, then don’t venture into this activity. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
There were 5 white guys at the Juneteenth event in Muskegon today. Four are seeking Political Office and one is a street activist. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter
The core issue of the Black Lives Movement is Human Rights. I’m Human, Hence, that explains why I advocate for The Movement. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
I bought the coke yesterday. But supporters of the FREEDOM CORNER effort bought all those bottles of water. Thank you to them and to all of you. PEACE !! #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/VTv7pJZVXT

I chanted this on FREEDOM CORNER tonight “since talking about skin color seems to bother some of you, let’s just talk about Human Rights then. What do you have to say about Human Rights?” PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
The FREEDOM CORNER experience and The BLACK EXPERIENCE have this in common. You have to live it in order to fully understand it. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

It’s interesting that some people want to talk about Politics on FREEDOM CORNER. And it’s only opponents to the messages. Supporters never bring up Politics. Maybe b/c they realize the vast majority of what is said has nothing to do with Politics. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

If any society wishes to achieve a state of PEACE amongst its own citizens, an agreement of what The Truth happens to be is a critical first step. Black Lives Matter is The Truth. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I used to think I had to do more than advocate on FREEDOM CORNER. Like get involved in other things in the community. At this point, I won’t force anything. If publicly advocating for the Movement is all I do, that’s good enough for me. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

I’ve been regularly chanting on FREEDOM CORNER while pointing to my BLM sign “if you oppose this message, oppose it w words. And be original. Say something nobody has said before today. At least bring a new perspective to the table.” I’ve heard ALM a lot less. #BlackLivesMatter

One main purpose of activism is to consistently raise awareness about an issue. I’d say overall the relationship between the Muskegon Police and its citizenry is decent. But PEACE is a battle. We must keep up the fight until our last breath. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

Black Men may flee The Police b/c their mindset may B “if I don’t try to escape, I’ll die. If I try to escape, maybe I’ll live.” I’m not Black so I’ll never fully understand it. I’m not speaking for Black People. I’m trying to get a better understanding. ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

Many people try to disrupt the FREEDOM CORNER vibe. Which is just a power play. They try to regain power via harsh words, insults, etc. That game is not played by me. The only response to everyone is PEACE ☮️. The power of PEACE and LOVE can’t be disturbed. #BlackLivesMatter

I chanted this tonight on FREEDOM CORNER tonight “some of you can’t say the words Black Lives Matter, but you’ll throw firecrackers in the air and talk about how great the USA happens to be. Who is it great for? What exactly are you celebrating?” #BlackLivesMatter PEACE ☮️

Some black guy (around 20 yo) called me a bitch on FREEDOM CORNER last night. I’m not sure if that were an insult or a compliment. But it doesn’t really matter what his intent was by saying that. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
Are you in SOLIDARITY with the Black Lives Movement? That’s a YES or NO question. No other words are necessary. But feel free to say whatever you wish. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

A few people displayed anger today claiming I should have better things to do than advocate for Black Lives on July 4th. lol 😂 I’m sure they won’t complain at all if they see me again. They just don’t like me advocating on holidays. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I’m aware publicly advocating alone is outside most people’s comfort zone. As well as most people’s interest. But I’ll say this. Allowing myself to B the sole focus of people’s reaction has given me a unique perspective. For me, there was no other way to learn. #BlackLivesMatter

I feel like getting some exercise. I’m not in the mood to verbally advocate for the Black Lives Movement. So I’ll just walk a mile or two with my BLM sign displayed with my fist raised in the air. It’ll be silent advocacy. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I showed this sign many times today. I was chanting “the effort here takes place for many reasons. One of which is to discover THE TRUTH. If the statement on this sign isn’t THE TRUTH, then please tell me what THE TRUTH happens to be using words.” #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/TDaXIuZ15f

The language of The Oppressor is demanding proof from The Oppressed that Oppression exists. Oppression exists because evil exists. There, I just proved its existence. Can we move forward now? PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I feel like rollerblading and advocating. I’ll just combine the two and do some advo-blading. I’ll skate around Muskegon while wearing my BLM shirt. If I’m stopped at an intersection I’ll raise my fist in the air. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter #IndigenousLivesMatter

I take breaks from FREEDOM CORNER here and there. Those breaks never last more than 10 days. It’s a physical and a mental break. I try not to overthink it. I always get back out there. Simply b/c it’s a big part of who I am. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter #indigenousLivesMatter

One of my most humbling moments as an activist was this. A local black lady knew about the FREEDOM CORNER effort. She saw me out there and called my name. I approached her and shook her hand. She later posted it was an honor for her to meet me. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter

People can oppose the FREEDOM CORNER effort however they choose. But unless they have the guts to publicly advocate their position in a similar manner, I have no reason to listen to them. But I’ll listen if they’re civil. PEACE ☮️ It’s time to advocate. #BlackLivesMatter

I chanted tonight on FREEDOM CORNER “words are the only weapon ever used out here. If you oppose the messages, oppose them w words. Be thoughtful and original. Say something nobody has ever said before today.” I practiced what I preached. PEACE ☮️ #BlackLivesMatter
It’s interesting that people who are the least affected and have no involvement at all in the Black Lives Movement usually claim to know the most about it. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

The language of The Oppressor is trying to get YOU to believe there’s something wrong w YOU because YOU support a legitimate Human Rights Movement. I hear that nonsense so frequently. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
If you can’t admit that OPPRESSION exists, it’s either because you’re really dumb or most likely because you support it. #BlackLivesMatter

At least once a month some random person will approach me on FREEDOM CORNER and proclaim they’re a “street preacher” as well. But they never advocate with me. Come on people, if you proclaim something, then show it. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

I had no clue 2 years ago that I’d evolve into a “street preacher”. That’s what I’ve become through repeated action. I try to never to lose sight of the messages and I know that’s what’s most important. It’s not about me. I’m just the messenger. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
I’ve always had an interest in doing local theatre. But, luckily, the FREEDOM CORNER effort has a theatrical element attached to it. It’s improv activism. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

The FREEDOM CORNER effort is “my way” of doing things. Is it the best way? I don’t really know. It will naturally lead to related efforts. It has already. And that will happen again. I’ve learned to just go about it one day at a time. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

Racism will never go away. That would be a foolish objective. The objective is to limit its effects by examining the Power Structures which allow it to continue. And then making necessary changes. PEACE ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter

The Oppressor will purposely make their own interpretation of the Black Lives Matter message. I’m not sure if this is done consciously or unconsciously. Some claim I’m saying this or I’m saying that. I’m the messenger. I get to tell you what I’m saying. ☮️!! #BlackLivesMatter
FREEDOM CORNER is calling my name. The words of PEACE and SOLIDARITY need to be heard. PEACE to everyone !! #BlackLivesMatter
